tooltip.geist.visor.scanner: Entity Scanner: brackets every creature in sight
tooltip.geist.visor.wear: Wear it on your head: right-click it, or press Z with it in your inventory
key.geist.toggle_hud: HUD on/off (puts the visor on if carried)
tooltip.geist.visor.hud: [Z] HUD on/off   [Hold X] Command wheel   [Hold C] Zoom
screen.geist.wheel.help: POINT AT ONE AND LET GO OF X · SCROLL FOR PAGE 2 · OR PRESS 1-6
message.geist.wheel_offline: The HUD is off - press Z to turn it on
module.geist.scan.desc: Outlines creatures; look at one to see its health and distance
module.geist.deep.desc: Radar, see mobs through walls, arrows to hostiles you can't see
module.geist.peek.desc: Look at a chest or barrel to see what's inside
module.geist.nav.desc: Coordinates, facing, biome, light level and the compass
module.geist.portal.desc: Look at a portal: where to build the linked portal
module.geist.ore.desc: Selected ores glow through walls (click to choose ores)
module.geist.vitals.desc: Exact health and food, armor wear and XP
module.geist.chrono.desc: Clock, time until night or sunrise, moon, area danger
module.geist.trajectory.desc: Where arrows and throws will land, plus aim help on a locked target
module.geist.filter.desc: Choose which ores Ore Pulse shows
tooltip.geist.smoke.what: Right-click: drop at your feet - a 7x7 cloud of thick smoke
tooltip.geist.smoke.blind: Creatures inside are blinded and lose track of you
tooltip.geist.smoke.visor: G.E.I.S.T. Visor: see through the smoke, blinded enemies outlined
tooltip.geist.copper_rod: Prototype stock. Conducts. Bends. Mostly holds.
tooltip.geist.exo_leg_frame: Iron, copper and two pistons bolted into the shape of legs
tooltip.geist.exo_core: Redstone heart, clockwork timing, spyglass targeting
tooltip.geist.exo.prototype: Prototype: wear it in your leggings slot
tooltip.geist.exo.leap: Sprint + jump: hydraulic leap (5-6 blocks high)
tooltip.geist.exo.fall: No fall damage up to 15 blocks, half damage beyond
tooltip.geist.exo.strength: Strength I and faster mining while powered
tooltip.geist.exo.fuel: Fuel: Redstone Dust or Copper Ingots (right-click them onto it, or carry them)
tooltip.geist.exo.drawbacks: Heavy: 10% slower walking. Empty: Slowness II. Deep water shorts it out
message.geist.exo.shorted: ⚠ EXO-FRAME SHORTED // get to dry land
message.geist.exo.dead_weight: ⚠ EXO-FRAME OUT OF POWER // dead weight
message.geist.visor_bound: Can't put the visor on: your helmet has Curse of Binding
tooltip.geist.gauntlet.prototype: Prototype: wear it in your chestplate slot
tooltip.geist.gauntlet.punch: Empty hand: punch for 10 damage, a little slower than a sword
tooltip.geist.gauntlet.barrage: Hold attack on a mob (or the barrage key): 0.5s wind-up, then ~4 punches a second for 3 damage each, up to 4s
tooltip.geist.gauntlet.cost: The barrage burns hunger fast, then the bracers vent steam and lock for 3-7s
tooltip.geist.gauntlet.throw: Sneak + right-click a mob to lift it overhead. Hold right-click to wind up, release to throw it like a football (up to ~30 blocks). Left-click slams it down. Creepers stay defused while held and blow up where they land
message.geist.gauntlet.hungry: Gauntlet // too hungry for a barrage
message.geist.gauntlet.starved: Gauntlet // out of fuel, barrage stopped
message.geist.gauntlet.no_grip: Gauntlet // can't get a grip on that
message.geist.gauntlet.carry_hungry: Gauntlet // too hungry to lift that
message.geist.gauntlet.carry_starved: Gauntlet // too weak to hold on
tooltip.geist.gauntlet.guard: Hold right-click with both hands empty to guard: blocks hits, arrows, explosions and the Warden's sonic boom from the front. Raise it just as a hit lands to parry
message.geist.gauntlet.lit: Gauntlet // it's lit! Too unstable to grab
tooltip.geist.mt7c.switch: [N] reconfigure the head: pickaxe, shovel, hoe
tooltip.geist.mt7c.breach: Hold right-click to charge, release to breach: a 2-5 block tunnel (pickaxe) or a 3x3 face 1-3 deep (shovel, hoe)
tooltip.geist.mt7c.quiet: Quiet: what it digs makes no vibrations; sculk and the Warden don't hear it
tooltip.geist.mt7c.cost: Every block costs durability; a breach costs hunger and the tool vents before the next one
key.geist.zero_light_mode: Zero Light: firing mode (standard / shockwave / ricochet)
tooltip.geist.zero_light.core: Light arrows: fast, flat, accurate. Fires your normal arrows
tooltip.geist.zero_light.shockwave: Shockwave: a full-draw shot bursts into an energy pulse (40 energy, 2.5 s between pulses)
tooltip.geist.zero_light.ricochet: Ricochet: arrows bounce off blocks up to 3 times, losing a little damage each time
